guides.title: Apply for leave
guides.blurb: Choose the dates and type, add a note or proof, and send.

steps.title: Apply for Leave
steps.text: Tap Apply for Leave.

steps.title: Dates
steps.text: The first and last day of your leave.

steps.title: Type of leave
steps.text: Annual, sick, family responsibility and so on. The days it will use are worked out for you below.

steps.title: A note
steps.text: Anything your manager should know.

steps.title: Proof
steps.text: If this leave needs proof (such as a sick note), add a photo or file here.

steps.title: Send
steps.text: Your manager gets it to approve. You'll see it under your requests until then.

guides.title: Submit a claim
guides.blurb: Claim back money you spent for work, with a receipt.

steps.title: Submit Claim
steps.text: Tap Submit Claim.

steps.title: Date
steps.text: When you spent the money.

steps.title: Type
steps.text: What it was for. Some types are worked out for you, for example kilometres driven times a rate.

steps.title: Amount
steps.text: The amount, or the kilometres or quantity, depending on the type.

steps.title: Receipt
steps.text: A photo of the receipt.

steps.title: Send
steps.text: It goes for approval, then to payroll.

guides.title: Update my details
guides.blurb: Change your phone number, email, address, emergency contact or bank details.

steps.title: Edit
steps.text: Tap Edit next to your name.

steps.title: Contact details
steps.text: Your cell number and personal email.

steps.title: Emergency contact
steps.text: Who to call if something happens to you at work.

steps.title: Address
steps.text: Where you live.

steps.title: Bank details
steps.text: Where your pay goes. Add proof, such as a bank letter; payroll checks it before it's used.

steps.title: Save
steps.text: Saves your changes.

guides.title: Read company documents
guides.blurb: Open a policy or notice and acknowledge that you've read it.

steps.title: Company Documents
steps.text: Tap Company Documents.

steps.title: Find a document
steps.text: Search, or filter by tag.

steps.title: Open and acknowledge
steps.text: Open a document to read it. If it asks you to, tap acknowledge once you've read it; your company sees that you did.
